utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina! The repair drive is this Saturday at my front porch, starting at 9 AM. Can you help out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can help. What kind of supplies are we still short on?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check my list—I think we still need more paintbrushes and wood filler. Can you bring any of those?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I heard you're involved in the repair drive too. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, thanks for offering! I think we're good on tools, but maybe you can help with the toaster Bo's bringing on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can take a look at that toaster. Any idea what's wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You didn't miss much, Dane. We're still getting folks to sign up—the Andersons are bringing their broken blender, so that's exciting!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I haven't seen any official notices posted anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's definitely happening! I saw the flyer at the community center—Sandra is organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye! I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday – got anything broken you want to bring by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh Jules, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center actually—can you update your flyers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Wait, really? I had it down for Saturday on the porch—thanks for the heads up, I'll fix those flyers right away!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is set for Saturday at 10 a.m. in the community center parking lot, behind the main building.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually Opal, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center—I'm bringing a box of screws and tools!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Cleo, I specifically checked the notice board yesterday—the sign clearly said Saturday at 10 a.m. Are you sure it changed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Is there a repair drive? I thought we were just talking about my toaster...

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Noah, it's this Saturday! Everyone's fixing up old bikes and gear. You should bring your toaster too—we'll figure it out!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday, huh? I'll try to remember that—but can you text me the address? My toaster's sitting on the counter right now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Leo, I'm organizing it this Saturday at my front porch. We'll be fixing up old bikes and appliances—I've already got my soldering iron ready for a blender.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring that rusty lawnmower. Got a car repair too—Johnson's needs a look.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A lawnmower should be fine, and I can take a look at Johnson's car if he brings it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? They're fixing old bikes and appliances this weekend—it's going to be a real community event!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've heard about it, but I'm worried we don't have enough people signed up to handle all the work—I don't want us to be overwhelmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, don't worry, I've been telling everyone I meet about it—I bet we'll get more volunteers by Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive! I've got a toaster I've been meaning to bring. What about you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm just helping organize the electronics. It's... a good distraction.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: A distraction, huh? Something going on?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rey, I'm glad you remembered your lamps—and I should remind Bo about his toaster too! We'll make a good team fixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm looking forward to seeing everyone's projects. It's nice to work together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rey! I'll make sure Bo brings that toaster—it'll be a fun challenge to fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Mara, I wasn't sure if I had anything worth fixing, but now I'm thinking maybe I should look around the house.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's a good idea, Ira! I've heard they can fix just about anything—do you have something specific in mind?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I do have that old desk lamp that's been flickering for months—maybe they can give it a second life.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Gus, I'm so glad you're here! The repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Can I count on you to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rosa! I'll let everyone know about the change—I'm heading to the hardware store later, so I'll spread the word along the way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus! I knew I could depend on you. Let me know if you need any flyers or anything to help share the news.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, just a heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, good to know—I'll let the other parents know at pickup today and make sure they've got the right details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye—I appreciate you helping spread the word. Let me know if anyone has questions about the new time!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, got it—it's for old tools and electronics, not cars. Thanks for the heads up!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Bo. Sorry I was late again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane. So I'm bringing my toaster, right? Just making sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard you're helping with the repair drive. That sounds like a good way to bring people together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I sure hope so! I just can't seem to keep the date straight in my head, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you like. I'm pretty good with dates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli. Here's the list—let me know if you spot anything we're missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I see a ratchet set on there. Might be worth adding a socket extender, for the tight spots.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good call, Uli. I'll add that to the list—those tight spots always sneak up on you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope we're not biting off more than we can chew with this repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ah, Pia, I've got it all planned out—tools sorted, neighbors signed up, we'll take it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Step by step sounds good, but who's going to handle the inventory of spare parts? That's where things always fall apart.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, got it fixed. Ready for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, so where and when exactly is this repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday, 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Quinn, I heard from Vik there's a repair drive this Saturday—you know more about it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yes, it's this Saturday! They're fixing up old bikes and collecting spare parts. Cleo's already bringing screws and tools—you should come help out!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful—I've been meaning to fix up my old bike for ages. I'll definitely swing by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks Rosa for the update! So it's Sunday at the community center now—I'll make sure to be there!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll mark my calendar. Do we need to bring anything specific, or just ourselves?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bring any old tools you've got, plus we could use spare parts like screws or hinges. Just showing up ready to work is plenty helpful!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Anyone else volunteered to help with the repair drive, or are we still in short supply?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, we're getting a little crew together! Dane said he'd come by, and Hana's helping spread the word—I think Vik mentioned the Andersons might bring their blender too!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That's good to hear, but do we have enough people to actually run the thing, or are we still scrambling?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh hey Noah, it's a repair drive! We'll have folks helping to fix things like toasters — you should bring yours!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mara, let me confirm the date. It's this Saturday at my front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that's right! Saturday at your front porch, starting at 10 AM. I'll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, Kira's got a point—I haven't seen any notices either. Maybe I just imagined the whole thing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it's real! I saw the flyer at the community center—it's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the park pavilion.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Saturday? I think I'm supposed to be at my sister's thing... or was that next week? Ugh, I always mix these up.
